The '''Cularin Spacer's Union''' was an organization that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a number of members of the Union attended a peace conference on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], which had been organized by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gavid Lermyn]].<ref name="Padawannabes">{{LivingForce|Jedi Code: Padawannabes}}</ref> Later, the Union sent a representative&mdash;[[Quinlu Naj]]&ndash;to represent then at the [[Cularin Trade Show]], a trade show that was held by the [[Cularin Trade Alliance]] aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[TAV Prosperity|TAV ''Prosperity'']].<ref name="FFAP">{{LivingForce|For Fun and Profit}}</ref>
